title: Separable polynomial for a compatible strict-henselization residue element
statement: Let g:T→S be a scheme morphism and k,k′ separably closed fields, Ω an algebraically closed field, σ:Spec k→S, τ:Spec k′→T, ι:Spec k′→Spec k with ι≫σ=τ≫g, and ν:Spec Ω→Spec k′. Let A be a strictly henselian local ring with separably closed residue field and B a henselian local ring (no separably closed residue-field hypothesis is required), eA:Spec A≅S_(ν≫ι≫σ), eB:Spec B≅T_(ν≫τ), and residue embeddings ρA,ρB whose composites through the closed-point and structural maps equal σ and τ. Let a:κA→k′ be the ring homomorphism corresponding to ι≫ρA and b:κB→k′ the one corresponding to ρB. For every x in κA there exists a nonzero separable polynomial p over κB such that evaluating the polynomial obtained by applying b to its coefficients at a(x) gives zero. This is a polynomial witness only; no preimage in κB is asserted. The scheme, geometric point, residue field, strictly henselian ring and strict-henselization constructions are those of [def-pc-scheme] [def-pc-separably-closed] [def-weil-geometric-point] [def-weil-residue-field] [def-weil-pbc-henselian-terminology] [def-weil-pbc-strict-henselization-limit] [def-weil-pbc-strict-henselization-structural-map].

proof.text: Give k′ its κB-algebra structure from the specified residue embedding. Apply compatibleStrictHenselization_residue_isSeparable with the reflexive compatibility equation to obtain separability of the image of each x in κA over κB.

Apply exists_separable_polynomial_of_isSeparable to that image element and the same residue embedding. Its minimal polynomial is nonzero, separable, and evaluates to zero, which is exactly the required polynomial.

lean.statement:
theorem Etale.compatibleStrictHenselization_residue_separable_polynomial
    {S T : Scheme.{u}} {g : T ⟶ S}
    {k k' Ω A B : Type u} [Field k] [IsSepClosed k] [Field k'] [IsSepClosed k']
    [Field Ω] [IsAlgClosed Ω] [CommRing A] [CommRing B]
    [HenselianLocalRing A] [HenselianLocalRing B]
    [IsSepClosed (IsLocalRing.ResidueField A)]
    (σ : Spec (.of k) ⟶ S) (τ : Spec (.of k') ⟶ T)
    (ι : Spec (.of k') ⟶ Spec (.of k)) (hι : ι ≫ σ = τ ≫ g)
    (ν : Spec (.of Ω) ⟶ Spec (.of k'))
    (eA : Spec (.of A) ≅ strictLocalization (ν ≫ ι ≫ σ))
    (eB : Spec (.of B) ≅ strictLocalization (ν ≫ τ))
    (ρA : Spec (.of k) ⟶ Spec (.of (IsLocalRing.ResidueField A)))
    (ρB : Spec (.of k') ⟶ Spec (.of (IsLocalRing.ResidueField B)))
    (hρA : ρA ≫ Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (IsLocalRing.residue A)) ≫
      eA.hom ≫ strictLocalizationToBase (ν ≫ ι ≫ σ) = σ)
    (hρB : ρB ≫ Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (IsLocalRing.residue B)) ≫
      eB.hom ≫ strictLocalizationToBase (ν ≫ τ) = τ) :
    ∀ x : IsLocalRing.ResidueField A,
      ∃ p : Polynomial (IsLocalRing.ResidueField B),
        p ≠ 0 ∧ p.Separable ∧
          p.eval₂ (Spec.preimage ρB).hom ((Spec.preimage (ι ≫ ρA)).hom x) = 0
lean.note: Retirement of the legacy Sheaf duplicate: use the already proved upstream declaration on strictLocalization and strictLocalizationToBase. Its binders and conclusion agree with the retired signature after replacing the legacy strictHenselizationScheme and strictHenselizationStructuralMap names. The canonical smallStrictHenselizationColimitIso identifies the two coordinate constructions. All public declarations in the upstream module are preserved verbatim.
